snippet.title: Spyder: Agent 8 | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Spyder: Agent 8 is coming on 11th February 2027 to Steam, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S!

Set in a retro-futuristic 1970s spy world, you play as Agent 8: the world's tiniest and most adorable robot spider superspy.

Your mission is to stop the evil organisation S.I.N and save the world. From rescuing astronauts to sabotaging a submarine or stopping a speeding train, every level is packed with tiny spy-sized missions. Use Agent 8’s gadgets to slip past obstacles, explore every corner, and uncover clever surprises. It’s all about problem-solving, stealth, and adventure!

Wishlist now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4265830/Spyder_Agent_8/
Epic Game Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/spyder-3536e1
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018168
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/spyder-agent-8/9NGWSJCJ35XM
